<script>
function shApplyFilters() {
  const search = document.getElementById('shSearch').value.toLowerCase().trim();
  const cat    = document.querySelector('input[name="cat"]:checked').value;
  const sort   = document.getElementById('shSort').value;
  const tags   = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.sh-filter-tags input:checked')).map(c => c.value);

  const grid   = document.getElementById('shCardsGrid');
  let cards    = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.sh-fcard'));

  if (sort === 'alpha') {
    cards.sort((a, b) => a.dataset.title.localeCompare(b.dataset.title));
  } else {
    cards.sort((a, b) => parseInt(a.dataset.order || 0) - parseInt(b.dataset.order || 0));
  }
  cards.forEach(c => grid.appendChild(c));

  let visible = 0;
  cards.forEach(card => {
    const cardCat   = card.dataset.cat;
    const cardTags  = card.dataset.tags.split(',');
    const cardText  = (card.querySelector('.sh-fcard-title').innerText + ' ' + card.querySelector('.sh-fcard-desc').innerText).toLowerCase();
    const matchCat    = (cat === 'all' || cardCat === cat);
    const matchTags   = (tags.length === 0 || tags.every(t => cardTags.includes(t)));
    const matchSearch = (search === '' || cardText.includes(search));
    const show = matchCat && matchTags && matchSearch;
    card.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
    if (show) visible++;
  });

  document.getElementById('shCount').innerText = visible;
  document.getElementById('shEmpty').style.display = visible === 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function shResetFilters() {
  document.getElementById('shSearch').value = '';
  document.querySelector('input[name="cat"][value="all"]').checked = true;
  document.getElementById('shSort').value = 'recent';
  document.querySelectorAll('.sh-filter-tags input').forEach(c => c.checked = false);
  shApplyFilters();
}

document.querySelectorAll('#shCardsGrid .sh-fcard').forEach((c, i) => c.dataset.order = i);
</script>
